description: Use when an agent needs a finished English due-diligence brief on a South Korean company. Input: one of business_number, dart_corp_code, stock_code or q (exact name); format=json|markdown; news=true|false. Output: JSON with executiveSummary, businessOverview, financialHighlights (each figure source-checked), procurementActivity, recentEvents (DART, 90 days), riskAssessment, sanctionsResult, dataGaps, sources. AI-written; not advice. Example: ?stock_code=005930 Price: $0.50 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

format.description: markdown adds a readable English Markdown rendering of the same report

news.description: Include up to 5 recent third-party news headlines (default true)

q.description: Company name (Korean or English), matched exactly after removing legal-form words

name: kr_company_report
title: Korean company due-diligence report in English: profile, registration, procurement, sanctions, recent DART filings and risk in one brief
